feeds.title: CMH - Classic Movie Hub Blog
feeds.description: Classic Movie Hub, the Classic Movie Cheerleader — where you can browse, discover and share your favorite films, stars, trivia, quotes, articles, charts, places to go, things to do and more! You can learn about classic movie news and upcoming events including screenings, festivals, blogathons, twitter parties, museum exhibits, and new book, CD and DVD releases.

feeds.title: Cinema Retro - Celebrating Films of the 1960s & 1970s
feeds.description: Cinema Retro is the only magazine dedicated to classic and cult films of the 1960s and 1970s. Among the many esteemed actors, writers, producers and filmmakers who have contributed to the magazine are Sir Roger Moore, Sir Christopher Lee, Hugh Hefner, Norman Jewison, William Shatner, Richard Schickel, Robert Vaughn, Richard Johnson, Don Knotts, David McCallum, Barbara Bouchet, Michael York, Cliff Robertson and many others.

feeds.title: Classic Movie Blog Association
feeds.description: The Classic Movie Blog Association (CMBA) is a group of blogs dedicated to the celebration of classic cinema.

feeds.title: Classic Movie Man - Stephen Reginald
feeds.description: This site is devoted to the love of classic movies. What qualifies as a classic film or movie is somewhat subjective. There are certain films which endure because they strike an emotional chord long after their initial release.

feeds.title: Out of the Past ~ A Classic Film Blog
feeds.description: A blog about classic film, old Hollywood stars, actors and actresses, directors,books about stars and movies and much more.

feeds.title: The Wonderful World of Cinema
feeds.description: The Wonderful World of Cinema is a blog created by Virginie Pronovost to share her passion about movies, especially classics. So, she write reviews, tributes (especially when it's one of her favourite actor's anniversary), top lists, opinion texts about her or about cinema in general.

feeds.title: Comet Over Hollywood
feeds.description: This website is for classic film lovers and explores different aspects of old movies-not just film reviews. From Musical Monday, to classic actress beauty tips to a look into the lives of favorite actors, they discuss their favorite films with daily photos posted and blog articles.

feeds.title: The Surreal Movies and TV Blog!
feeds.description: I am the PROUD owner of this movie blog! I have been blogging on here since 2014 and I've been looking for more new weird movies to review on this blog! I have always loved anything that was weird, whether it be plastic skulls or watching weird movies and TV shows in general. So, I decided to create a blog where I talk about everything that is weird and hoping to find other bloggers who love weird movies and TV shows like I do!

feeds.title: Classics Old Movies
feeds.description: Explore Classic old movies that capture timeless charm, captivating performances, and cinematic artistry. They transport us to bygone eras, immersing us in rich narratives and unforgettable characters. A testament to the enduring power of cinema, these films hold a special place in our hearts, captivating audiences across generations.

feeds.title: The Old Hollywood Garden
feeds.description: The Old Hollywood Garden reminisces the best years, moments, stories, and people of Old Hollywood. Enjoy Film reviews. Lists, Double Bill suggestions, in-depth character analysis, Hollywood and life anecdotes, and more miscellaneous stuff. Author Carol is a screenwriter, playwright, and full-time blogger.

feeds.title: Shadowsandsatin
feeds.description: Step into the world of fedoras, trench coats, and neon-lit streets as we dissect the intricate plots, character dynamics, and underlying themes that define the Film Noir genre. Shadowsandsatin is a Film Noir blog dedicated to presenting stimulating discussions and reviews on select classic movies.

feeds.title: Taste of Cinema - Criterion Film Reviews and Classic Film Lists
feeds.description: Taste of Cinema is not just another movie list website, their focus on World Cinema and Classics make us different. They make essential film lists introducing the best films from different filmmakers, countries, genres and eras, these in-depth lists not only serve as guides to good movies, but also give you a bigger picture and thorough understanding of the film culture about a certain country, genre or cinema movement.

feeds.title: Silver Scenes - A Blog for Classic Film Lovers
feeds.description: Covering the world of classic movies from the silents to the mid 1960s via bios, movie reviews, rare photos and fun trivia.

feeds.title: Greenbriar Picture Shows
feeds.description: Classic movie blog with rare images, original ads, and behind-the-scenes photos, with informative and insightful commentary.

feeds.title: Classic Film and TV Café
feeds.description: The Classic Film and TV Cafe is a blog devoted to classic movies and television series, ranging from the silent film era to the 1980s. Come into the Cafe and join in the conversation!

feeds.title: Pre-Code.Com - Celebrating Pre-Code Hollywood Cinema, 1930 - 1934
feeds.description: This blog was created to celebrate everything pre-Code Hollywood (1930 to 1934)! Learn more about what this exciting era of classic film was by following.

feeds.title: Laura's Miscellaneous Musings
feeds.description: Laura G is Lifelong Film Fan, Sharing Thoughts on Classic Films and Disney, along with Miscellaneous Musings, since 2005.

feeds.title: Silver Screenings Blog
feeds.description: We adore old movies and believe they are good for you, like expensive chocolate and the spa. Fashionably filmy movie blogger.

feeds.title: The Blonde at the Film - Cameron
feeds.description: Cameron is writer and classic Hollywood historian. She is providing what she hope are enjoyable, informative, and lovely essays on movies that she find interesting, beautiful, funny, or special.

feeds.title: Grand Old Movies Blog
feeds.description: Our blog covers the films of Hollywood's Golden Age - movies that came out during the 1930s, 40s, 50s, and 60s, produced by such great Hollywood studios as MGM, Warner Bros., Paramount, 20th-Century Fox, and Columbia. We'll even look at movies produced by the not-so-great outfits - Monogram and PRC - when the mood strikes.

feeds.title: Once upon a screen - a classic film and TV blog
feeds.description: Aurora is Classic film-obsessed blogger and influencer. Social Media instructor, manager and content specialist. Co-founder and co-host of the 'Classic Movies and More'

feeds.title: Those obscure objects of desire
feeds.description: Stela is a long time fan of classic movie with a special interest in classic actresses. This blog is a result of months spent pouring over old newspapers and books.

feeds.title: The Flapper Dame - A 'Wannabe' Flapper blogging about Hollywood's Golden Era
feeds.description: The Flapper Dame Emily's blog is about her major interests in Classic Film, British Royalty, and History.

feeds.title: A Classic Movie Blog
feeds.description: A review site for classic film fans. Recommended discs, books, podcasts, streaming picks, and more.

feeds.title: In The Good Old Days Of Classic Hollywood
feeds.description: Hi I'm Crystal, I'm a classic film enthusiast, and have been passionate about the golden age for years. Some of my favourite stars include: Ethel Barrymore, Bette Davis, Katharine Hepburn, Carole Lombard among others. I study journalism at the Morris Journalism Academy, and I have commenced research for a proposed classic film biography.

feeds.title: The Hollywood Revue
feeds.description: The Hollywood Revue blog is all about anything and everything related to the world of classic film: movie reviews, book reviews, news, lists, and anything else.

feeds.title: Backlots - Lara G. Fowler
feeds.description: Backlots is devoted to honoring and celebrating all aspects of classic film and is written by Lara Gabrielle Fowler, a California-based classic film writer and historian.

feeds.title: Classic Movies Digest
feeds.description: Classic Movies Digest is a blog showcasing films and stars from Hollywood's Golden Age. Rupert have also written several eBooks on classic Hollywood.

feeds.title: The Miss Hollywood Blog
feeds.description: Covers a variety of cinema and television-based topics and works. From an impassioned musing on the merit of silent pictures (even in the modern age) to an analysis of the comedic and structural genius of the 90s sitcom, The Nanny, The Miss Hollywood Blog blog can satisfy all of your visual media analysis hunger.

feeds.title: Journeys in Classic Film - Kristen Lopez
feeds.description: Journey's in Classic Film seeks to discuss films, classic and undiscovered. From insights into the film industry, film essays, and film reviews, this blog hopes to entice people into discovering classic cinema.

feeds.title: Classic Film Freak - Classic Hollywood and Her Classic Films
feeds.description: A Blog about Not the biggest, but some of the best original and insightful commentary on Old Hollywood.
